question:
❌ Every student have completed the assignment.

Correct

✅ Every student has completed the assignment.

Rule

Every → Singular

❌ One of the engineers are absent today.

Correct

✅ One of the engineers is absent today.

❌ Neither the manager nor the employees was ready.

Correct

✅ Neither the manager nor the employees were ready.

Rule

Verb agrees with the nearest subject.

❌ The committee have submitted its report.

Correct

✅ The committee has submitted its report.

❌ Mathematics are an interesting subject.

Correct

✅ Mathematics is an interesting subject.

❌ Hardly had I reached than it started raining.

Correct

✅ Hardly had I reached when it started raining.

❌ No sooner had he arrived when the meeting started.

Correct

✅ No sooner had he arrived than the meeting started.

❌ He is good in Mathematics.

Correct

✅ He is good at Mathematics.

❌ She insisted to attend the meeting.

Correct

✅ She insisted on attending the meeting.

❌ The news are encouraging.

Correct

✅ The news is encouraging.

Identify the error.

Each of the students have submitted the report.
Neither Rahul nor his friends was present.
He prefers coffee than tea.
I have been living here since five years.
The teacher as well as the students are happy.
She is one of the best players who plays consistently.
Everyone have completed the coding challenge.
The furniture are expensive.
Scarcely had I entered than the bell rang.
The project was completed successful.
Each employee have completed the training.
Neither the teacher nor the students was present.
answer: ❌ was ✅ were Rule Nearest Subject Rule

question: The manager along with his assistants are attending the meeting.
answer: ❌ are ✅ is Rule "Along with" does not change the subject.

question: She has been working here since three years.
answer: ❌ since ✅ for Rule For → Duration Since → Starting Point

question: No sooner had I entered when everyone stood up.
answer: ❌ when ✅ than Rule No Sooner → Than

question: Hardly had we reached than the train departed.
Everyone have submitted their assignments.
The committee have announced its decision.
answer: ❌ have ✅ has Rule Committee acting as one unit.

question: She is married with an engineer.
He is capable to solve difficult problems.
The information are useful.
He explained me the solution.
answer: ❌ explained me ✅ explained the solution to me Rule Explain → Explain to someone

question: One of the players have scored a century.
answer: ❌ have ✅ has Rule One of → Singular

question: The scenery are beautiful.
She insisted to attend the interview.
answer: ❌ to attend ✅ on attending Rule Insist on

question: What is Error Detection?
answer: Error Detection is the process of identifying grammatical, vocabulary, punctuation, or logical mistakes in a sentence.

question: Which grammar topic is asked most frequently?
answer: Subject-Verb Agreement is one of the most frequently tested grammar concepts.

question: How do you solve Error Detection questions quickly?
answer: Identify the subject, verify the verb, check tense consistency, examine pronouns, articles, prepositions, and finally verify the sentence meaning.

question: Why is logical meaning important?
answer: A sentence can be grammatically correct but still be logically incorrect. Both grammar and meaning must be checked.

question: How can grammar be improved?
answer: Practice daily, revise grammar rules regularly, solve placement questions, and read English newspapers and books.
